description: Data-driven vulnerable-runtime floors: language runtimes with a known critical engine-level vulnerability, the patched floor per maintained branch, and the branch below which no patch exists. scan_runtime_floors.py flags repo declarations (composer.json, Dockerfiles, docker-compose, setup-php workflows) pinned to or capped below these floors. Adding the next engine-level event is a data edit, not a code change.

advisories.title: PHP2Shell: unauthenticated RCE and memory disclosure in the PHP engine
advisories.summary: Stale request-owned global state (fatal-error backtrace, session upload progress, OPcache) reused across requests by a persistent worker gives unauthenticated remote code execution and Heartbleed-style process-memory disclosure on any PHP deployment, independent of the application. Present for over a decade; every PHP release back to 5.4 is affected. Exploit traffic observed before public disclosure.
advisories.eol_note: The PHP Foundation ships the fix only for 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12. PHP 8.1 and older receive no patch; the only remediation is upgrading to a patched branch.
